description: Use to list one seller's storefront. Products listed by a seller: a storefront search. Takes the same filters as search -- query, page, sort_by, category_id, min_price / max_price, product_condition, brand, today_deals, deal_type -- and answers with filters_applied, filters_ignored and available_filters like search does. Price: $0.003 per call. A malformed seller_id is a free 400, as on seller_profile_batch. metadata.total_pages counts every page of the result (48 rows a page), but Amazon serves at most 7 pages of one query: metadata.reachable_pages is how far page can go, and when it is less, pagination_note says how to see the rest (min_price/max_price bands or category_id). _links.next is the next page while there is one; a page past the end is a free 400 page_out_of_range. Invalid sort_by, price, product_condition or deal_type is a free 400 that lists the allowed values. No single sort order lists a whole storefront: Amazon's relevance order (the default) can count far fewer products than the store holds and repeats products across pages, and other orders include products it leaves out (measured on one store: relevance 321, NEWEST 1,898; on another, relevance and NEWEST shared 90 of 161 products). Page 1 of a storefront without `query` carries `coverage_note` with the recipe: page through sort_by=RELEVANCE and sort_by=NEWEST, split a store larger than 336 products into min_price/max_price bands, dedupe by asin. An empty storefront carries `note`: Amazon reports 0 products for a seller with no listings on that marketplace and for an id that is not a seller alike, so check it with seller_profile_batch (`_links.seller_profile`). Rows have the search row shape: `offers_count` is null unless the card shows a count, and `product_brand` is null on most storefront cards (Amazon prints no brand line there; product_details has `brand_name`).

brand.description: Brand name as Amazon spells it (case-insensitive), e.g. Samsung.
brand.title: Brand

category_id.description: Amazon browse node id to restrict to, e.g. 172282 (Electronics on US). Take one from a best_sellers answer's available_subcategories, a product's category_path, or node= in an Amazon URL. Ids differ per marketplace.
category_id.title: Category Id

compact.description: Return light rows: identity, price, rating, badges and one delivery_date, dropping the long delivery prose that repeats itself across three fields. false returns every field the REST API sends (roughly 3x the size).
compact.title: Compact

deal_type.description: A specific promotion refinement: today_deals, all_discounts, coupons or buy_more_save_more. available_filters.deal_type lists the ones this marketplace has.
deal_type.title: Deal Type

fields.description: Comma-separated row fields to return instead of the light set, e.g. "asin,product_title,product_price". Rows list what they left out under _omitted_fields.
fields.title: Fields

limit.description: How many the seller's products to return from this page (0 = all of them). A full page is up to 48 rows and about 54 KB, which most clients spill to a file instead of showing inline. The answer carries _truncated with the true count when it trims.
limit.title: Limit

max_price.description: Highest price, in the marketplace currency.
max_price.title: Max Price

min_price.description: Lowest price, in the marketplace currency; decimals such as 19.99 are fine.
min_price.title: Min Price

page.description: Result page, 1-based. metadata.total_pages says how far it goes.
page.title: Page

product_condition.description: NEW, USED or RENEWED (case-insensitive). Applied with the marketplace's own condition node; where a marketplace does not offer one, the answer's filters_ignored says so and available_filters lists what it does offer.
product_condition.title: Product Condition

query.description: Optional keywords to search within this seller's storefront.
query.title: Query

seller_id.description: Amazon seller id whose storefront to list: 'A' followed by 9-20 letters and digits, the seller= or me= value of a storefront URL (e.g. A2A1RNLLUK3HYA). Required.
seller_id.title: Seller Id

today_deals.description: Only items in Today's Deals, using that marketplace's own refinement. Where a marketplace has none (amazon.fr on 2026-09-08) it is reported under filters_ignored.
today_deals.title: Today Deals

name: seller_products
title: Products listed by a seller
